scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.

cases.required_definition: Phase1 number=existing execve number, args=[1, sign-extended dirfd, unchanged filename address, descriptor physical address, sign-extended flags,0]. Phase2 rewrites number and args0=2,args1=descriptor physical address,args2=descriptor byte length only; args3,4 retain prior initialized values and args5 retains0.
cases.transport: Write individual raw fields of MaybeUninit<SyscallRequest>; do not materialize/write a whole SyscallRequest before helper-owned rtid/ttid/valid initialization. Retain original offload/send/publish order and ordinary phase1 completion boundary before phase2 mutation.
cases.proposal_status: Existing ExecPhase1TransportSeed/aggregate-write proposal is NOT APPROVED: replace it, removing invented ID/valid/unused-slot seeds. Whole exec-body selection remains outside this review.

cases.required_definition: Initialize exactly x86 six argument fields: rdi=original thread.proc.pid converted as original C to CULong; rsi=original tid likewise; rdx=original signed CInt sig converted to CULong; r10/r8/r9=0. Preserve arg0 even though current host kill handler semantically uses only1/2. Forward unchanged __NR_kill62.
cases.transport: Raw MaybeUninit<X86UserContext> storage and raw addr_of_mut field writes. After all six fields initialized, selected generic forwarding only scalar-reads those fields. Do not form a whole context reference/assume_init/copy whole context; preserve current thread/process/lock/send/error/logging lifetime and ordering.

cases.required_definition: Mask: six context argument fields [original CULong sigmask,0,0,0,0,0], unchanged custom __NR_rt_sigprocmask14. Action: [original signed sig converted to CULong, unchanged handler bit/address representation, original flags,0,0,0], unchanged custom __NR_rt_sigaction13. Preserve arg2 flags despite current selected handler ignoring it.
cases.transport: Use raw MaybeUninit context, initialize all six scalar fields before forwarding; do not create whole-context initialized references. Preserve valid/aligned borrowed action and original handler-before-flags reads. Preserve validation and action/mask publication order; no Linux syscall argument-shape substitution.
cases.proposal_status: Current initialized-context prefix candidate does not implement this newly authorized constructor; fresh raw-six-field successor required before selection.

cases.required_definition: Event4 only and existing dynamic debug enabled: exact prefix ptrace_wakeup_sig,pid=%d,data=%08x\n; first variadic value is signed32 CInt, second is result as u32/CUInt, lower hexadecimal width minimum8 zero padded; -1→ffffffff. Other events emit nothing. Retain logical /src/kernel/syscall.c, ptrace_wakeup_log_bridge, line24429, original metadata/flag/read order.
cases.limits: This intentionally defines a previously mismatched signed variadic argument; no undefined C-output parity assertion or ptrace/signal/action change. No additional cast through signed64/usize.

cases.required_definition: Only host-failed-to-load-ELF errno and preparing-ranges/args/envs/stack ret diagnostics change %d→%ld, each with the same existing signed CLong ret, event and logical source metadata. Preserve text/newline otherwise, no i32 truncation, no return/errno/negation/kill/control-flow change.
cases.limits: Existing ret is C long, including the range-preparation int widened by original assignment; x86_64 CLong i64 is the correct vararg domain. No undefined variadic parity claim.

shared_constraints: The byte transport and diagnostic/marshal layers may inspect/copy all six initialized slots; PASS does not mean they never read semantically unused slots.

Existing helpers retain rtid/ttid writes, caller valid0 and copied-packet Release valid1 publication. No new whole request/packet/context/UTI/response zero, ACK, identity seed, response status or endpoint assumption.
Request72/align8 and packet128 are retained source ABI facts. Stack/wire-copy/lifetime alignment and pending ABI29/codegen proof remain separate.
Raw argument projection references are permitted only after those scalar fields are initialized. No whole partially initialized aggregate reference or typed load is approved.

Phase2 mutation needs the same genuine existing completion and exclusive-borrow lifetime as the original code. No new ACK inference or descriptor/filename/argv/envp/VM/thread lifetime closure is supplied.

C fallback and Rust helper host handlers were checked at their actual narrow semantic fields; concrete selected runtime/source provenance and build/default/native gates must still bind the final implementation.
This source decision neither proves undefined parity nor clears a genuine service/account/rejected-operation hold. Missing provenance is not clearance.
